CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_GRP__ShipmentMainConsol] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT csp.ShipmentID , csp.ConsolidationShipmentPivotKey , csp.ConsolidationID , csp.ConsolidationKey , c.LoadPort , c.DischargePort , ConsolDischarges.Discharges , LoadPortCountryCode = LEFT(LoadPort, 2) , DischargePortCountryCode = LEFT(DischargePort, 2) FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__ConsolidationShipmentPivot csp JOIN InternationalLogistics.BAS__Consolidation c ON c.ConsolidationKey = csp.ConsolidationKey JOIN ( SELECT JS = csp1.ShipmentID, Discharges = LEFT(STRING_AGG(CAST(c1.DischargePort AS VARCHAR(MAX)), ', '), 8000) FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__ConsolidationShipmentPivot csp1 JOIN InternationalLogistics.BAS__Consolidation c1 ON c1.ConsolidationKey = csp1.ConsolidationKey GROUP BY csp1.ShipmentID ) AS ConsolDischarges ON ConsolDischarges.JS = csp.ShipmentID
